subject: SET statement
notes: 'The effect of the SET statement on the function whose address is being stored in the function-pointer is implementor-defined.' The whole obligation is to SAY what the effect is, and Annex A.1 item 174 makes saying it REQUIRED - so this rule closes only with its DOC row, which docs/CONFORMANCE.md section 7 DOC-A.1-174 now carries. The determination is NONE: taking a function's address performs no activation, no loading, no linking, no allocation and no initial-state establishment, because a function-pointer here IS the externalized function-name (8.4.3.12.4 GR2) and FunctionAddressOf performs a registry LOOKUP only. Witnessed rather than asserted: the 2014 golden activates FUNCTION PBF8DBL(21) BEFORE the first SET and AFTER the last and both print 000000042, so the function's result cannot depend on whether its address was taken.
